findings.explanation: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Windows (Splunkbase 742) is irrelevant to SNMP/API tape library slot capacity monitoring.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace with references to tape library SNMP MIBs or vendor backup/tape management documentation.

findings.explanation: Describes general disk storage and snapshot management rather than physical tape cartridge slots and expiring tape media.
findings.quote: We watch how full your storage is getting and give you time to add space or clean up snapshots and old data before an application or job suddenly stops working.
findings.suggested_fix: Explain in plain terms that this monitors available physical slots in tape libraries and flags tapes expiring soon so backups don't run out of media.

summary: The use case exhibits heavy automated template artifacts in descriptions and test scenarios, lists an irrelevant Windows Add-on reference for tape library SNMP monitoring, and uses generic snapshot cleanup wording in grandmaExplanation.
